drug_class: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) inhibitor; tyrosine kinase inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces ceritinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; use alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit extract/seed
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases ceritinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue; allow 3-day washout before ceritinib use

avoid_supplements.name: Milk thistle
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce ceritinib bioavailability

avoid_supplements.name: Goldenseal
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase ceritinib levels and adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for toxicity

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce ceritinib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; inform healthcare provider of use

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inducer; minimal clinical impact at standard doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard culinary amounts; high supplemental doses may warrant monitoring

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/pomelo/Seville oranges
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases ceritinib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet during ceritinib therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase ceritinib absorption; requires consistent intake pattern
caution_foods.action: Take ceritinib consistently with or without food; do not vary pattern significantly

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds with weak CYP1A2 activity; minimal impact on CYP3A4
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; consume normally as part of healthy diet

monitoring_notes: Monitor ceritinib efficacy and tolerability closely when initiating or changing concomitant CYP3A4 modulators. Assess for gastrointestinal toxicity, QT prolongation, and hepatotoxicity; maintain consistent meal patterns to avoid pharmacokinetic variability.
